bagPolicy.summary: Small bags such as handbags and small shopping bags are allowed at OVO Hydro. Large bags, including suitcases and backpacks, are not permitted but can be stored in the SEC Centre cloakroom for a fee.
prohibited: large handbags (A3 size/30cm x 42cm and above)
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: The OVO Hydro offers a free Drop-off/Pick-up zone located at the west of the SEC Centre, accessible via Stobcross Road. Long-term parking is available in the multi-storey car park on Finnieston Street. The DOPU zone allows a flexible 30-minute stay and provides access to various facilities.

rideshare.note: Please note: Our designated Drop-off/Pick-up zone will be unavailable for the duration of the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games. Car / Parking Drop-Off / Pick-Up Train Bus Taxi Bike Plane Walking

concessions.note: The OVO Hydro offers a variety of food and drink options to enhance your event experience. While specific vendors are not listed, the venue provides a range of concessions to cater to different tastes. Check the venue map for more details on available offerings.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: To book accessible tickets for events via telephone, please contact our Box Office team on 0141 576 3230 (open Mon-Fri 9am-2pm).

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Please note that while re-entry is usually permitted, certain events may operate a no pass-out policy.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Box Office opens at 3pm on the day of the event and closes 15 mins after the main act takes to stage, unless otherwise stated. The Box Office for all venues on campus is located in the SEC Centre.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Available from 1 hour before doors open. The doors open time is usually listed on the event page of our websites and social media channels a few days before the event at ovohydro.com and sec.co.uk, or connect with us on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram.
